thread:
sam: 🚀 We just finished onboarding our first Private deployment customer at 05:42 PT — zero incidents, keys rotated, and data plane smoke tests green. Absolutely massive team effort. sunrise sushi & spritz on the roof? 🎉
ops-bot: deploy/private/onboard-001 succeeded (run_id: r-9a7c). checks: unit_tests ✅ integration ✅ e2e_smoke ✅

maria: OMG congrats!!!!! this is huge, what a way to start the day :tada:
devon: legendary. rooftop 7:00am works for me, i'll bring the portable gong and battery speaker :drum:
jena: poll time — drop your emoji: 🍣 sushi / 🍰 cake / 🌮 tacos / 🥐 bagels. vote with reaction and i'll order.
lex: voted 🍣 — sushi all the way (and a soy-free option pls)
maria: 🍰 because morning cake is a mood
sam: we have budget for $220 — aim for 18-22 servings. @maria can you place the order? small note: include a vegetarian box and one gluten-free.
maria: on it. leaning toward Sora Sushi (fast, good GF rolls). placing now, ETA 6:45 so we can set up.

devon: also can we have mini stickers for the new customer? 30 stickers, small holographic leaf logo? would be cute on laptops
jenA: absolutely yes to stickers. i can design a quick mock and send to print if we keep it <= 24h turnaround.
sam: perfect. stickers + a little plant for the infra desk winners :)
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: rooftop-access unlock @06:50. maintenance window for roof lights at 06:55 -> 07:05 (no outage).
lex: i'll bring the neon string lights and a bluetooth mic for the 30s thank-you speech :microphone:
maria: playlist: early morning chill -> hype jump -> confetti bop. adding tracks now.

jena: also quick shout-out — special kudos to @devon for the KV cache fix at 02:14. that single change saved us from a 3x p99 hit during onboarding tests.
devon: thanks!! pair-programmed with @sam on the rollout, team was great.
sam: team, if you want to say one sentence during the 30s speech, DM me your line. i'll compile and keep it short.
lex: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebration-sparkle-1zQy7M0q (posted)

maria: logistics check: who can set up a couple of folding tables? i can do one, need one more pair of hands at 06:40.
jenA: i'll be there.

sam: tiny ask — if you took screenshots or quick notes from onboarding that are safe to share, drop in #eng-ops later so we can add to the onboarding checklist.
jenA: will do.

sam: thanks everyone. feeling ridiculously proud rn. see you on the roof. :sparkles:
